description: This file defines a class JwtTokenGenerator responsible for creating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using specified options. It encapsulates token creation logic, including setting claims and signing the token.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JWT tokens based on provided issuer options.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a signed JWT token for the specified username, including standard claims.
